title: Edron Goblin Quest
name: Edron Goblin Quest
location: Edron Goblin Cave, west of town
legend: Rob the greedy goblins of their small treasure.

title: The Desert Dungeon Quest
name: The Desert Dungeon Quest
legend: An old myth, nearly buried by the sands of time has been discovered by brave adventurers who ventured themselves through the complicated Desert Dungeon, and found its secret.

title: The Annihilator Quest
name: The Annihilator Quest
legend: Deep in the earth, near hell, the demons guard their great treasure, who only the bravest could dare to retrieve!

title: Short Sword Quest
name: Short Sword Quest
legend: When Amber sailed to Rookgaard on her raft she forgot her notebook and now she wants it back.

title: Blood Herb Quest
name: Blood Herb Quest
legend: Wyda the witch talks about the usefulness of this herb. It grows near dead trees, perhaps you should try the dead tree not far from her house?

title: Dead Archer Quest
name: Dead Archer Quest
legend: An archer lost his way and died by poison.

title: Elvenbane Quest
name: Elvenbane Quest
legend: An Elf Arcanist hoards treasure in his highly fortified castle.

title: Battle Axe Quest
name: Battle Axe Quest
legend: Someone died in the sewers while carrying an axe.

title: Troll Cave Quest
name: Troll Cave Quest
location: Edron Troll Cave, west of town

title: Fanfare Quest
name: Fanfare Quest
legend: Some Trolls stole a fanfare.

title: The Postman Missions Quest
name: The Postman Missions Quest
location: Begins in Kevin's office at the Tibia Postal Service Headquarters, but takes you all over Tibia.
legend: It is very hard to become a postman so Kevin has a five step course of Assistant Postman, Postman, Grand Postman, Grand Postman for Special Operations, and Arch Postman.

title: Small Health Potion Quest
name: Small Health Potion Quest
legend: Billy will reward those who will help him

title: Spike Sword Quest
name: Spike Sword Quest
location: A few steps north east of Triangle Tower
legend: A warrior journeyed too far into the earth

title: Thais Lighthouse Quest
name: Thais Lighthouse Quest
legend: A guy managed to imprison two cyclopes in the lighthouse basement and forced them to make weapons.

title: Emperor's Cookies Quest
name: Emperor's Cookies Quest
legend: Emperor Kruzak has some cookies for you.

title: Triangle Tower Quest
name: Triangle Tower Quest
legend: Three users of magic plot in a tower filled with undead.

title: Katana Quest
name: Katana Quest
legend: A Rookgaard warrior ventured into a cave, met monsters he couldn't defeat, and his loot can be found at the place of his death.

title: Pick Quest
name: Pick Quest
legend: It seems a traveler died when he took the wrong way to some dirty beasts, instead of going trough poison gas and find the treasure guarded by dark magic. - from a once found report. (Katana Quest Cave).

title: Minotaur Hell Quest
name: Minotaur Hell Quest
legend:
There is a book in Mino Hell saying: The mystic portal remains unstable so reinforcements from Mintwallin seldom arrive here. 
The royal mage managed to impress the primitive local orcs though and we can use them as slaves and runefodder. The trolls surrendered immediately and can be used for lesser services.
The human base has to be destroyed since more and more arrive there. These enemies are not strong but their number might cause some problems. As long as they will be revived at this mystic vortex even they can ruin our plans. We have to figure out how to destroy the vortex first. The mage locked himself up in his quarters and wants not to be disturbed anymore. He entrusted me with the duty to coordinate all our actions here.

title: Present Quest
name: Present Quest
legend: Seymour is searching for a suitable box that he wants to give to the king.

title: Captain Iglues Treasure Quest
name: Captain Iglues Treasure Quest
location: Below the Rookgaard Poison Spider tower.
legend: An old captain has hidden some of his most precious belongings deep below the island of Rookgaard.

title: The Queen of the Banshees Quest
name: The Queen of the Banshees Quest
location: Isle of the Kings underground and Ghostland
legend: You have to complete 7 seals to get to the final room with the rewards. Do not enter the third floor on Isle of Kings or you will have to pay a certain amount of money. Teleporting out means you have to get on the isle using the pearl seal.

title: Studded Legs Quest
name: Studded Legs Quest
legend: Someone really loves flowers, especially honey flowers...

title: The Paradox Tower Quest
name: The Paradox Tower Quest
legend: Surpass the wrath of a madman and subject yourself to his twisted taunting.

title: Orc Shaman Quest
name: Orc Shaman Quest
location: Venore Orc Cave, east of Venore
legend: An orcish shaman is protecting his treasure in a small orcish outpost near Venore.

title: Circle Room Quest
name: Circle Room Quest
legend: A dwarven garrison guards a valuable treasure in a room deep underneath the surface.

title: Alawar's Vault Quest
name: Alawar's Vault Quest
legend: Alawar has hidden his treasure, which is guarded by his fierce minotaurs and dangerous magical fields.

title: Noble Armor Quest
name: Noble Armor Quest
location: Deep in a hidden cave below Mt. Sternum.

title: Draconia Quest
name: Draconia Quest
legend: You will need to solve riddles to get the keys and go up in the pyramid.

title: Crusader Helmet Quest
name: Crusader Helmet Quest
location: Dwarf Mines west of Kazordoon or north of Thais, 126.170.
legend: The Dwarves have hidden a shiny helmet deep in their mines, guarded by giant spiders..

title: Giant Smithhammer Quest
name: Giant Smithhammer Quest
legend: The cyclopes are great metal smiths and use a giant smithhammer in one of their camps.

title: Longsword Quest
name: Longsword Quest
location: Dusalk's Troll Clan Cave, near Dwarf Bridge
legend: A traveling family was attacked, and their items were hidden by the trolls and minotaurs.

title: Doublet Quest
name: Doublet Quest
legend: Some adventurer used to store his loot under a loose board in the stable to the north next to some strange note on the wall. He might have forgotten something when he left.

title: The Outlaw Camp Quest
name: The Outlaw Camp Quest
legend: The outlaws have secured a very strong sword, and have it protected with traps and puzzles.

title: Black Knight Quest
name: Black Knight Quest
legend: The former commander of the Royal Army was abandoned by his fellow humans and now has some bones to grind with them...

title: The White Raven Monastery Quest
name: The White Raven Monastery Quest
location: Near Carlin, (Ghostlands and the Isle of the Kings)
legend: There is an island inhabited by an order of monks, one of those monks has gone missing in the Ghostlands.

title: Geomancer Quest
name: Geomancer Quest
location: Mount Sternum Undead Cave, vicinity of Thais

title: Griffin Shield Quest
name: Griffin Shield Quest
location: Gates of Demona, deep inside the Maze of Lost Souls, Near Carlin and Ab'Dendriel
legend: A group of explorers tried to get into Demona and died on their way.

title: Iron Hammer Quest
name: Iron Hammer Quest
legend: An elite group of Cyclopish warriors lost their valuable hammer during a war against the Minotaurs.

title: Iron Helmet Quest
name: Iron Helmet Quest
legend: A friend of Muriel's tried to escape the Plains of Havoc, but did not make it out alive.

title: Mad Mage Room Quest
name: Mad Mage Room Quest
legend: The Mad Mage summoned more monsters than he could handle.

title: Naginata Quest
name: Naginata Quest
legend: Deep inside a dragon-filled place a treasure is hidden...

title: Orc Fortress Quest
name: Orc Fortress Quest
legend: The Orc King hoards a treasure in his throneroom, guarded by the best warriors of the fortress.

title: Ornamented Shield Quest
name: Ornamented Shield Quest
legend: The last remaining warrior of the Nightmare Knights was said to have been mortally wounded by dragons to eventually die below the Plains of Havoc.

title: Power Bolts Quest
name: Power Bolts Quest
legend: A Nightmare Knight on his way back to Knightwatch Tower fell down a hole and died to a Giant Spider.

title: Skull of Ratha Quest
name: Skull of Ratha Quest
legend: A member of the Explorer Society tried to find out more about the Venore Amazon Camp and lost his way.

title: Barbarian Axe Quest
name: Barbarian Axe Quest
legend: The orcs on Edron guard their equipment well in their underground hideout.

title: Berserker Treasure Quest
name: Berserker Treasure Quest
legend: The orcs on Edron hoard a small treasure in their cave.

title: The Djinn War - Marid Faction
name: The Djinn War - Marid Faction
legend: Ally with the Marids, an ancient race of Djinns to obliterate their counterparts, the fearsome Efreets, and gain eternal trust from those powerful creatures.

title: The Djinn War - Efreet Faction
name: The Djinn War - Efreet Faction
legend: Ally with the mighty Efreets, a powerful race nearly forgotten by the sands of time, to obtain victory in the everlasting djinn wars against their counterparts, the fearsome Marids.

title: Dark Armor Quest
name: Dark Armor Quest
legend: A warrior has been killed by a Giant Spider deep in the Edron Orc Cave.

title: Fire Axe Quest
name: Fire Axe Quest
legend: An adventurer died in the midst of many dragons.

title: The Ancient Tombs Quest
name: The Ancient Tombs Quest
legend: Seven advisors of the Pharaoh were "entrusted" with the secret to forge part of an ancient powerful mask, and they will fight for an eternity to keep it.

title: Medusa Shield Quest
name: Medusa Shield Quest
legend: The chief Necromancers of the Brotherhood of Bones hold a valuable treasure here.

title: Parchment Room Quest
name: Parchment Room Quest
legend: Someone has set up a dangerous trap to protect an important key.

title: Plate Armor Quest
name: Plate Armor Quest
legend: There is a ghostship that haunts the waters between Venore to Darashia.

title: Poison Daggers Quest
name: Poison Daggers Quest
legend: The orcish shamans use poisonous equipment for their rituals.

title: Shaman Treasure Quest
name: Shaman Treasure Quest
legend: The orcish shamans hoard magical equipment in their hideout.

title: Vampire Shield Quest
name: Vampire Shield Quest
legend: A warlock and some heroes guard their treasure in the caves beneath Edron.

title: Elephant Tusk Quest
name: Elephant Tusk Quest
location: East of Port Hope in Tiquanda

title: Double Hero Quest
name: Double Hero Quest
legend: Two heroes are guarding a precious treasure deep inside the Hero Cave.

title: Steel Helmet Quest
name: Steel Helmet Quest
legend: A minotaur gang's hideout contains stolen items from Kazordoon.

title: The Explorer Society Quest
name: The Explorer Society Quest
location: Begins in Port Hope or Northport, but requires travel throughout Tibia.
legend: The Explorer Society is a noble order of explorers who have ventured themselves to the very core of the Tibian realm. You can join this society and raise in rank by helping them with their exploration.

title: Hydra Egg Quest
name: Hydra Egg Quest
legend: Overcome a hydra and enter its nest to grab a Hydra Egg.

title: Explorer Brooch Quest
name: Explorer Brooch Quest
location: North side of The Jolly Axeman Tavern in Kazordoon
legend: A member of the explorer society drank too much, and was possibly killed in a brawl in the Jolly Axeman Tavern.

title: Sam's Old Backpack Quest
name: Sam's Old Backpack Quest
legend: Sam, the blacksmith of Thais, used to be an avid explorer and he lost his backpack on one of his adventures.

title: Six Rubies Quest
name: Six Rubies Quest
legend: Some fierce dragons are guarding their treasure with fire.

title: The Ape City Quest
name: The Ape City Quest
legend: The renowned Merlkin Hairycles is trying to find true friends amongst the humans. To prove that you can be one of those friends, you must help the apes.

title: Isle of the Mists Quest
name: Isle of the Mists Quest
location: Isle of the Mists, Near Kazordoon and Venore
legend: Some tibian vocations have special places, where only that vocation can enter. Druids are not an exception. If you are a druid, try to find your own place and you will receive your prize.

title: Beggar Outfits Quest
name: Beggar Outfits Quest
legend: Ah, Hugo is working on designing this look. He might need some inspiration, so if you have some time to spare, don't hesitate to contribute some ideas to him.

title: Knight Outfits Quest
name: Knight Outfits Quest
legend: If you spend your time fighting monsters and need that little extra protection, this well-armored outfit is great for you. Addons are usually awarded by knight guilds.

title: Hunter Outfits Quest
name: Hunter Outfits Quest
legend: A light and comfortable ranger outfit which every paladin simply loves to wear. If you are looking to earn addons for this outfit, a good place to start would be the Thais paladin guild.

title: Barbarian Outfits Quest
name: Barbarian Outfits Quest
legend: This outfit stands for raw power, battle cries and lack of manners. I heard that there are a few barbarians living near Northport. They might just be able to provide fitting addons.

title: Wizard Outfits Quest
name: Wizard Outfits Quest
location: Lugri (Thais), The Queen Of The Banshees (Ghostlands)
legend: Are you feeling evil today? This outfit is fitting for mages pursuing the dark side of sorcery. Shunned by the magic academy of Edron, you might find wizards hiding near Thais.

title: Assassin Outfits Quest
name: Assassin Outfits Quest
legend: Mysterious and lethal, assassins are hard to find and almost impossible to befriend.

title: Pirate Outfits Quest
name: Pirate Outfits Quest
legend: Yo ho ho and a bottle of Rum! If you love the pirate way of life and sneer at landlubbers, this might be the right outfit for you. Pirates are said to roam the Shattered Isles...

title: Shaman Outfits Quest
name: Shaman Outfits Quest
legend: If you have seen everything and worn every look, this outfit will put the icing on your cake. Maybe you can earn it by becoming the apprentice of a Shaman... or voodoopriest.

title: Citizen Outfits Quest
name: Citizen Outfits Quest
legend: Your basic starter outfit - simple, but practical. If you are looking to earn addons for this outfit, you should walk around Thais and look for citizens wearing a hat or a backpack.

title: Mage Outfits Quest
name: Mage Outfits Quest
legend: Great for wise old male mages as well as for pretty enchantresses. If you are looking to earn addons, ladies should take a stroll in Port Hope, whereas elders should explore the Dark Cathedral.

title: Oriental Outfits Quest
name: Oriental Outfits Quest
legend: This comfortable, yet fashionable outfit will create the romantic mood of thousand and one nights. A good place to look around for addons are naturally Darama and Ankrahmun.

title: Nobleman Outfits Quest
name: Nobleman Outfits Quest
legend: One of our finest pieces. If you have the money and wish to show how wealthy and noble you are, this is the outfit for you. We also create addons especially for you, right here.

title: Summoner Outfits Quest
name: Summoner Outfits Quest
legend: Great for young mages and ladies who love witchcraft. If you are looking to earn addons, gentlemen should take a stroll in Port Hope, whereas ladies should explore the Dark Cathedral.

title: Warrior Outfits Quest
name: Warrior Outfits Quest
legend: The lighter version of the knight outfit is great if you want to save stamina and maintain agility. Addons are usually awarded by knight guilds.

title: Druid Outfits Quest
name: Druid Outfits Quest
location: Ceiron (Ab'Dendriel), Ustan (Port Hope), A Majestic Warwolf (Cormaya)
legend: Nature-loving and peaceful druids might like this outfit, especially the beastlike addons. I heard that there is a druid living near Ab'Dendriel, who might be able to provide fitting addons.

title: The Shattered Isles Quest
name: The Shattered Isles Quest
location: Liberty Bay, Meriana, Goroma, Nargor, Edron
legend:
You are pitted in a battle between the peace loving freedom fighters of Meriana and the pillaging foul hordes of Nargor. Your mission is to overcome the pirates of Nargor and help the pirates of Meriana attempt to bring peace to Liberty Bay.

Be careful! There's a storm in the way between Thais and Liberty Bay that may trap the ship and interrupt your trip.

title: Exchange Quests
name: Exchange Quests
legend: You can acquire Quest Items by giving NPCs items dropped by monsters.

title: Citizen Outfits Quest on Rook
name: Citizen Outfits Quest on Rook
legend: The same addons earned in Mainland.

title: Druid Outfits Quest on Rook
name: Druid Outfits Quest on Rook
legend: The same addon earned from Ustan in Mainland.

title: The Pits of Inferno Quest
name: The Pits of Inferno Quest
location: Pits of Inferno, under the Plains of Havoc; entrance near the Necromant House.
legend: The once glorious Nightmare Knights have established themselves under the fiery pits of inferno to fight off evil. The pits of inferno however contain thrones that have a little of the spirit of each of the ruthless seven trapped in there. Absorb their spirit to claim your prize!

title: Dreamer's Challenge Quest
name: Dreamer's Challenge Quest
location: Abandoned Monastery and under Plains of Havoc in Dream Realm
legend: In order to join the ranks of the Nightmare Knights or the Brotherhood of Bones, you must pass the dream challenge to prove that you are worthy. You have to slay a lot of demons to prove that you are worthy, though.

title: The Ice Islands Quest
name: The Ice Islands Quest
legend: The jarl, Sven the Younger is not too keen in accepting new citizens in the barbarian settlement of Svargrond, and for that reason he will  submit you to a few quests. If succeeded, you will be able to help the other barbarians that are in dire need of help.

title: Skeleton Decoration Quest
name: Skeleton Decoration Quest
legend: They say a group of frost giants tortured a prisoner and stole his money.

title: Norseman Outfits Quest
name: Norseman Outfits Quest
legend: Are you feeling cold in this never ending winter of Hrodmir? Perhaps this outfit might fit you.

title: Frost Dragon Quest
name: Frost Dragon Quest
legend: The Frost Dragons of Okolnir guard a small treasure in their home.

title: Berserk Potion Quest
name: Berserk Potion Quest
legend: An adventurer who died on Helheim left behind some useful items.

title: Inukaya Quest
name: Inukaya Quest
location: Inukaya, the Chakoyas encampment near Svargrond

title: Lion Trophy Quest
name: Lion Trophy Quest
legend: It seems a poacher found his way into the mines, but did not make it out alive.

title: Formorgar Mines Quest
name: Formorgar Mines Quest
legend: An adventurer exploring the icy mines ventured deeper in than his powers accommodated...

title: Formorgar Mines Hoist Quest
name: Formorgar Mines Hoist Quest
legend: With this quest, you can have access to the Hoist at the Formorgar mines entrance. Using it, you will be able to go to another floors more easily.

title: What a Foolish Quest
name: What a Foolish Quest
location: In and around Thais, Edron, Cormaya, Kazordoon, Carlin, Venore, Port Hope, Liberty Bay, and several other locations
legend: This outfit is ideal for any tibian who loves clowning around or joking other people.

title: Secret Service Quest
name: Secret Service Quest
location: Begin: Thais, Venore or Carlin. Includes travel through all of Tibia.
legend: The Secret Services from Carlin, Thais, and Venore want to find out all secrets in Tibia...

title: Nomads Land Quest
name: Nomads Land Quest
legend: Some thieves have stolen something very valuable to the nomads.

title: Into The Bone Pit Quest
name: Into The Bone Pit Quest
legend: Muriel is researching for a spell against the undead.

title: The Exterminator Quest
name: The Exterminator Quest
legend: The Carlin sewers may be the source of a plague!

title: The Ultimate Booze Quest
name: The Ultimate Booze Quest
legend: The recipe to make the legendary dwarven beer is a well kept secret.

title: To Appease the Mighty Quest
name: To Appease the Mighty Quest
legend: The Efreet and Marid and fought for eons, yet maybe the humans can make peace with them.

title: To Blind the Enemy Quest
name: To Blind the Enemy Quest
legend: The elves need your help in a war against nearby villains.

title: To Outfox a Fox Quest
name: To Outfox a Fox Quest
legend: Budrik has been robbed by the The Horned Fox and this time it's personal!

title: Against the Spider Cult Quest
name: Against the Spider Cult Quest
legend: The orcs in Edron have started breeding giant spiders and are becoming a serious threat. The town needs a hero to stop them.

title: The Travelling Trader Quest
name: The Travelling Trader Quest
location: Svargrond, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Ankrahmun, Darashia, Edron and Carlin. Missions also take you to Outlaw Camp, Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel and the inner parts of Tiquanda.
legend: Rashid is searching experienced traders, so he can buy their goods. You have to pass a test to prove yourself a worthy trader, one new task each day in a whole week.

title: Kissing a Pig Quest
name: Kissing a Pig Quest
location: All Free Account Cities, Femor Hills, Ghostlands/Isle of the Kings
legend: An evil witch has cursed Princess Shantalla into a life as a pig until the best kisser in the world gives her a kiss.

title: Waterfall Quest
name: Waterfall Quest
legend: A pirate forgot his treasure in a cave in the waterfalls near the traitorous nest of the feared Hydras.

title: Marlin Trophy Quest
name: Marlin Trophy Quest
legend: The Marlin is a rare fish, perhaps you can find a collector to trade with.

title: Strong Potions Quest
name: Strong Potions Quest
legend: A couple of priestesses are guarding something very valuable to them.

title: The Inquisition Quest
name: The Inquisition Quest
legend: The bravest Tibian players are called to free Tibia from all evil Demons.

title: The Thieves Guild Quest
name: The Thieves Guild Quest
location: Thais, Carlin, Outlaw Camp, Venore, Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Dark Cathedral
legend: An underground guild has formed under Thais. Join them by talking to Dorian and learn some of their tricks.

title: The Beginning Quest
name: The Beginning Quest
legend: Santiago, Zirella and Carlos all need help. Will you be the brave adventurer to assist them?

title: The Hunt for the Sea Serpent Quest
name: The Hunt for the Sea Serpent Quest
legend: There are rumours of Sea Serpents that roam the northern seas and attack ships.

title: Elemental Spheres Quest
name: Elemental Spheres Quest
legend: One of the experiences of Magister Alverus went wrong, and now he is frozen in one of the Ivory Towers in Edron. Only with the power of four vocations together (each with an element) can this great alchemist be saved.

title: Troll Sabotage Quest
name: Troll Sabotage Quest
legend: The trolls destroyed the home of the poor Jerom. And now when he planned to open a new store! You can help him to get revenge on the trolls who did this evil to him.

title: The Demon Oak Quest
name: The Demon Oak Quest
legend: The Ruthless Seven have sent a powerful demonic being to the Plains Of Havoc. Do you have what it takes to stop it?

title: Vampire Hunter Quest
name: Vampire Hunter Quest
legend: If you encounter one of the Vampire Lords and slay it, it will drop proof of its death. Storkus might be interested.

title: The Blessed Stake Quest
name: The Blessed Stake Quest
location: Ab'Dendriel Carlin Kazordoon Thais Venore Darashia Ankrahmun Edron Port Hope Liberty Bay
legend: According to a myth, it is said that a person can extract the essence of an unholy creature using a blessed artifact.

title: In Service of Yalahar Quest
name: In Service of Yalahar Quest
legend: The new found island of Yalahar needs to be investigated thoroughly.

title: Blood Brothers Quest
name: Blood Brothers Quest
legend: Yalahar is under attack by vampires, help Julius to save Yalahar!

title: The Hidden City of Beregar Quest
name: The Hidden City of Beregar Quest
location: Beregar, Fenrock, Mistrock, Ab'dendriel, Yalahar, Venore, Kazordoon.
legend: There is a tale that concerns a long lost tribe of dwarfs that allegedly settled on one of the islands around Yalahar. Once a brave warrior returned from a journey and vividly described a huge city that he had discovered, inhabited by dwarfs, but nobody believed him.

title: Top of the City Quest
name: Top of the City Quest
legend: A masked man has just stolen Iriana's earnings and she needs your help to retrieve them. The chase may not be as easy as it seems, though.

title: Killing in the Name of... Quest
name: Killing in the Name of... Quest
legend: The dangerous creatures which plague the lands are becoming increasingly threatening. The townspeople may need some assistance in dealing with them...

title: The Isle of Evil Quest
name: The Isle of Evil Quest
location: Kazordoon, Yalahar, Liberty Bay, Northport, Isle of Evil, Thais
legend: Ancient texts and fairy tales tell of a secret isle of evil...

title: The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest
name: The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest
location: Around Thais - Eclesius' house, Venore, Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel, Carlin
legend: Eclesius is looking for a new assistant

title: Hot Cuisine Quest
name: Hot Cuisine Quest
location: West of the Blue Djinn Fortress, Near Ankrahmun
legend: Jean Pierre needs some help with his cooking...

title: Treasure Hunt Quest
name: Treasure Hunt Quest
location: Liberty Bay, Edron, Tiquanda, Nargor and more.
legend: Arrr! Find the treasure...

title: Shadows of Yalahar Quest
name: Shadows of Yalahar Quest
legend: The brilliant Yalahari created golems to suit their needs, but this is not as easy a task to do for todays scientists.

title: Pilgrimage of Ashes Quest
name: Pilgrimage of Ashes Quest
location: various locations in tibia, starts at any city guide.

title: Braindeath Quest
name: Braindeath Quest
legend: A brave adventurer died facing the evil Braindeath.

title: The New Frontier Quest
name: The New Frontier Quest
location: Farmine, Zao, Kazordoon, Edron, Venore, Thais, Port Hope, Isle of Strife.
legend: After centuries the resources beneath and around the Big Old One became alarmingly short. Some decades ago, the imperial mining guild financed a project to search and establish new mines far away from Kazordoon.

title: Sea of Light Quest
name: Sea of Light Quest
location: Edron and Lost Mines (west of town), Vega
legend: None.

title: Children of the Revolution Quest
name: Children of the Revolution Quest
legend: None.

title: Unnatural Selection Quest
name: Unnatural Selection Quest
location: Mostly Zao Mountain, but takes you all over Tibia.
legend: Help the cavemen prepare for their hunt.

title: An Uneasy Alliance Quest
name: An Uneasy Alliance Quest
legend: The leader of the orcs of Zao, the minotaur Curos, will accept help from humans, but it will not be easy to earn his trust.

title: Tomes of Knowledge Quest
name: Tomes of Knowledge Quest
location: Zao, Chazorai, Dragonblaze Peaks, Farmine, Muggy Plains and Zzaion.
legend: Perhaps you can help an old dwarf in his quest for knowledge and get something out of it yourself as well...

title: A Father's Burden Quest
name: A Father's Burden Quest
location: Edron, Zao Wailing Widow Cave, Isle of the Kings, Barbarian Settlements, Dwarf Mines, Thais Dragon Lair, Banuta, Ankrahmun Tombs
legend: A Father wishes to get his four sons gifts on their mutual birthday.

title: Wrath of the Emperor Quest
name: Wrath of the Emperor Quest
location: Primarily Zao including the Zao Rebel Camp and Razachai, Banuta
legend: Help Zalamon in his fight against the corrupted Emperor.

title: The Spirit Will Get You Quest
name: The Spirit Will Get You Quest
location: Souleater Mountains in Zao, near the Zao Rebel Camp.
legend: An old lizard needs help to fulfill the last wishes of her family. Or does she?

title: An Interest In Botany Quest
name: An Interest In Botany Quest
legend: Rabaz got an ambitious interest in plants, maybe you can help him out collecting some samples.

title: Rise of Devovorga
name: Rise of Devovorga
legend: A powerful ancient weapon meant to be sleeping forever has awoken deep under Vengoth. Portals all over the world lead to fragments of its shattered soul. With thirst for revenge and burning rage she will destroy the world - unless you fight her back.

title: Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest
name: Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest
legend: The outlaws are in hard times and are looking for someone to help them...

title: Jack to the Future Quest
name: Jack to the Future Quest
legend: Spectulus need some help.

title: Research and Development Quest
name: Research and Development Quest
legend: Spectulus and Sinclair need some help with ghost research.

title: Spirithunters Quest
name: Spirithunters Quest
location: Edron, Ghostlands, Drefia or Mount Sternum Undead Cave or Dark Cathedral, Vengoth Castle or Vandura Mountain or Yalahar Cemetary Quarter, Deeper Banuta or Zao.
legend: Sinclair needs someone to catch spirits for him using a Spirit Cage for some ghastly research.

title: The Lightbearer
name: The Lightbearer
legend: In that special time of the year when the veil between the worlds is thin and darkness is striving to break through, Lucius calls for Lightbearers to keep sacred light basins burning for four days. Don't let even one go out or all hope is lost.

title: Bewitched
name: Bewitched
legend: To avert the wrath of evil spirits, all Tibians will have to help the good witches to create a powerful spirit brew. Gather exotic ingredients and protect the witches' cauldron from the forces of destruction.

title: A Piece of Cake
name: A Piece of Cake
location: Carlin, Thais, Edron, Darashia or Liberty Bay during the first stage. Cake Keep Isle south of Cormaya on the second stage.
legend: Defeat the invading cake golems and use the corpses of your conquered enemies to build a bridge to a legendary island reachable only once a year. There you will have to face a challenge unlike any before. Grab your fork and be ready.

title: The Colours of Magic
name: The Colours of Magic
legend: A contest between three wizards has spread across all Tibia so that mysterious letters with coloured powders can now be found everywhere. Choose your wizard and make your friends join your cause - what is your true color?
active_time: March 15th–23rd and September 15th–23rd (+7 days of rewards)

title: Demon's Lullaby
name: Demon's Lullaby
location: Starts in Jakundaf Desert. Random: Ab'Dendriel, Draconia, Kazordoon, Venore, Vega, any Wheat Field and more.
legend: A mother's burden becomes a hero's burden when a demon mother decides to take a few days off. Guard and satisfy her horrible little children to avert her wrath and earn a reward. Be warned: Demon babies might prove too hot to handle.

title: Annual Autumn Vintage
name: Annual Autumn Vintage
legend: Winterberries can now be found all over Tibia! The Combined Magical Winterberry Society wants YOU to help gathering them and, of course, process them to create the juice that keeps the magic in the world flowing - good treading!
active_time: October 1st–8th and October 17th–24th (+7 days of rewards)

title: A Pirate's Death to Me
name: A Pirate's Death to Me
location: Thais Lighthouse, cave below Calcanea and Ghost Ship.
legend: Help a cursed pirate in his desperate voyage that may free his soul once and for all. Join forces with old and new friends bound by fate and the stars to form a crew and sail the ghastly oceans of the netherworld with all its perils.
active_time: Friday–Monday, if Friday falls between the 18th and 23rd, except March<!-- The Colours of Magic -->, September<!-- 2nd The Colours of Magic --> and October<!-- 2nd Annual Autumn Vintage --> and, if [[A Piece of Cake]] or [[Bewitched]] are active during these conditions, then also February or June, respectively (+5 days of rewards)<!-- since Spring into Life is not a world event, it doesn't block worlds tasks in April -->

title: Last Creep Standing
name: Last Creep Standing
legend: Test your ability in a challenge of wits and agility. Will your world be richly blessed or will you leave Kurik unimpressed?
active_time: 20th–25th of every month, except March<!-- The Colours of Magic -->, September<!-- 2nd The Colours of Magic --> and October<!-- 2nd Annual Autumn Vintage --><!-- since Spring into Life is not a world event, it doesn't block worlds tasks in April -->

title: Lone Medusa Quest
name: Lone Medusa Quest
legend: A lonely medusa is guarding her treasure.

title: Thornfire World Change
name: Thornfire World Change
legend: When the bog god arose in Shadowthorn there was conflict between the god's followers and those who would not follow. These others rebelled by starting fires around the town. Once they were contained the town was safe, but only as long as they cannot get free.

title: Twisted Waters World Change
name: Twisted Waters World Change
location: Lake Equivocolao in Tiquanda, north of Port Hope.
legend: Lake Equivocolao is the only known home to the Shimmer Swimmer, but they only appear when the lake is filthy.

title: Elementalist Outfits Quest
name: Elementalist Outfits Quest
legend: A magical tower has appeared east of Edron out of the blue. A mad mage without any connections to the Academy has created this building and conducted several experiments there - some of which failed quite horribly.

title: Afflicted Outfits Quest
name: Afflicted Outfits Quest
legend: You feel close to the victims of the fever outbreak. Your clothes make you one of them, one poor soul amongst the countless afflicted

title: Swamp Fever World Change
name: Swamp Fever World Change
legend: The easily treatable swamp fever afflicts only the poorest of Venore, but the cure can be found nearby.

title: Demon Wars World Change
name: Demon Wars World Change
legend: Below Edron, two Demon races, the Shaburak Demons and the Askarak Demons, are waging war against each other since ages and for reasons long forgotten.

title: Awash World Change
name: Awash World Change
legend: The remains of a sunken dynasty of unknown origin can now be accessed beneath Kazordoon.

title: The Mage's Tower World Change
name: The Mage's Tower World Change
legend: A mage in Zao has created a portal to another dimension, which can only remain open while he is alive.

title: The Mummy's Curse World Change
name: The Mummy's Curse World Change
legend: A pharoah resides in his tomb, but can be awakened again.

title: Their Master's Voice World Change
name: Their Master's Voice World Change
legend: A mad mage built a tower in Edron to conduct experiments.

title: Overhunting World Change
name: Overhunting World Change
location: Forests around Ab'Dendriel and near Carlin and the Orc Fortress
legend: A fine balance lies between the lives of the White Deer of Ab'Dendriel's forest and the Wolves.

title: Insectoid Invasion World Change
name: Insectoid Invasion World Change
legend: Insectoids invade Greenshore and will destroy the land if not killed.

title: Loose Ends Quest
name: Loose Ends Quest
location: Ankrahmun, Edron, Outlaw Camp, Thais and Venore.
legend: Loose Ends is a quest for characters who left the Isle of Destiny designed to show them easy quests to gain quick rewards. It is added to your quest log immediately after Captain Kurt sails you off of the Isle, and will disappear once all NPCs have been talked to.

title: Horse Station World Change
name: Horse Station World Change
location: East of Thais, West of Venore.
legend: Stable horses can be rented, but sometimes they escape to roam with wild horses and must be rounded up.

title: Steamship World Change
name: Steamship World Change
legend: An old dwarven explorer has discovered a new steamship route between Thais and Kazordoon.

title: Minotaur Leather Quest
name: Minotaur Leather Quest
legend: There's a suspicious raft south of Thais guarded by minotaurs.

title: Iron Ore Quest
name: Iron Ore Quest
legend: The dwarfish miners may have left traces of the materials they mined.

title: Silver Amulet Quest
name: Silver Amulet Quest
legend: Trolls hide their precious silver necklace from intruders.

title: Deeplings World Change
name: Deeplings World Change
legend: Unknown.

title: Hive Born World Change
name: Hive Born World Change
legend: A War Against the Hive is being fought. If the Hive is weakened, it may be possible to advance further into it.

title: Liquid Black Quest
name: Liquid Black Quest
legend: Spectulus discovered a strange island.

title: War Against the Hive Quest
name: War Against the Hive Quest
legend: The Hive Born threaten the world and must be stopped.

title: Insectoid Outfits Quest
name: Insectoid Outfits Quest
legend: The Hive Born threaten the world and must be stopped.

title: Spring into Life
name: Spring into Life
legend: Several adventurers reported unusual activities in almost all known dragon lairs. Lots of dragon eggs have been sighted in their caves and it is only a question of time when the next generation of these nasty creatures will be incubated...

title: Bigfoot's Burden Quest
name: Bigfoot's Burden Quest
legend: The Gnomes are threatened by a hostile force that bleeds this race to a slow but certain death. Therefore, they asked their dwarven allies for support. That is why the dwarfs are now looking for courageous warriors to join the gnomish troops to assist them in their distress. Are you willing to join the Bigfoots, the gnomish brigade which is fighting against the evil menace?

title: Realm of Dreams Quest
name: Realm of Dreams Quest
legend: Guarded by fire and dark walls, a long forgotten secret lies...

title: Venore Daily Tasks Quest
name: Venore Daily Tasks Quest
legend: Norman The Foreman can always use an extra hand to help out.

title: Goblin Merchant Quest
name: Goblin Merchant Quest
legend: Rafzan can always use an extra hand to help out.

title: Demon Outfits Quest
name: Demon Outfits Quest
legend: Find a hero who appreciates your fight against the demons of Tibia.

title: The Gravedigger of Drefia Quest
name: The Gravedigger of Drefia Quest
legend: If you are not afraid to participate in dark ceremonies you should search for Omrabas and offer your help. He has something very handy as reward for your assistance.

title: Hunting for Tokens Quest
name: Hunting for Tokens Quest
legend: Jorge needs raid tokens to study the essence of raid monsters. In return, he will carve or replicate a rare item.

title: The Repenters Quest
name: The Repenters Quest
legend: Use a special copper key to enter the door to the path that leads you to Hellgate. Once you are there, search for those who atone for the sins of their ancestors. Offer your help and make life easier for them, at least temporarily. If you manage to accomplish all tasks in one day, the repenters might reward you with something special.

title: Opticording Sphere Quest
name: Opticording Sphere Quest
location:
Ab'Dendriel, Horestis Tomb, Venore, Fiehonja, Gnomebase Alpha, Dwarf Mines,
Otherworld (Dwarf Bridge), Krailos, Replica Dungeon, Gnome Deep Hub and The Cube (Location).
legend: Investigate mysterious locations around Tibia and dive into the history of the Planegazers.

title: Spike Tasks Quest
name: Spike Tasks Quest
legend: Help the Gnomes to fight their enemies around The Spike.

title: Roshamuul Quest
name: Roshamuul Quest
legend: Nightmarish creatures are lurking in an island recently found by the Inquisition...

title: Sinatuki Quest
name: Sinatuki Quest
legend: An outcast Chakoya is hungry...

title: Glooth Engineer Outfits Quest
name: Glooth Engineer Outfits Quest
legend: The Rathleton Magistrate may reward people dedicated to their city with an outfit and its addons.

title: Dark Trails Quest
name: Dark Trails Quest
legend: The citizens of Rathleton need help investigating the strange behavior of the city beggars.

title: Oramond Quest
name: Oramond Quest
legend: The citizens of the recently discovered city of Rathleton require assistance in defending their civilization against various threats.

title: Rathleton Quest
name: Rathleton Quest
legend: The magistrates of Rathleton would gladly promote you within their ranks if you can fulfil their requirements.

title: Dawnport Quest
name: Dawnport Quest
legend: Mr Morris is in need of help with his research.

title: Sanctuary of the Lizard God Quest
name: Sanctuary of the Lizard God Quest

title: Lion's Rock Quest
name: Lion's Rock Quest
legend: A rock formation has been discovered north-west of Darashia.

title: The Cursed Crystal Quest
name: The Cursed Crystal Quest
legend: Strange things started happening after the pirates of Nargor began mining crystals in a cursed cave...

title: Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest
name: Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest
legend: Deep under the Sea, a Fire Feathered Serpent sleeps, but its Guardian needs help protecting their realm.

title: Hero of Rathleton Quest
name: Hero of Rathleton Quest
legend: Old enemy of Rathleton, Jaccus Maxxen, is a threat to the city..

title: Cartography 101 Quest
name: Cartography 101 Quest
location: Begin at Adventurers' Guild, then all over the Tibian lands.
legend: The Adventurers' Guild need some help cartographing the Tibian lands.

title: The Lost Brother Quest
name: The Lost Brother Quest
legend: Help a merchant find out what happened to his brother who followed a beautiful woman into a luxurious palace.

title: The Great Dragon Hunt Quest
name: The Great Dragon Hunt Quest
legend: Rumour has it plenty of treasure has been hoarded by the dragons in the Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs...

title: The Tainted Souls Quest
name: The Tainted Souls Quest
location: Tainted Caves in the Green Claw Swamp.
legend: Release the Tainted Souls roaming the Green Claw Swamp from their plight.

title: Grimvale Quest
name: Grimvale Quest
location: Grimvale, Edron, Venore Corym Cave, Cormaya, Darashia, Hyaena Lairs, Lion Sanctum, Ankrahmun and Oskayaat.
legend: A terrible curse transforms the inhabitants of a small island north-east of Edron into dangerous were-creatures on every full moon. Can you help them or succumb to their horrible fate?

title: Asura Palace Quest
name: Asura Palace Quest
legend: A mysterious door in a mysterious palace...

title: Nightmare Teddy Quest
name: Nightmare Teddy Quest
legend: Nightmarish creatures are guarding something very appropriate to their nature...

title: Bank Robbery Mini World Change
name: Bank Robbery Mini World Change
location: Ab'Dendriel (Dwarf Mines), Carlin (Ghostlands), Thais (Ancient Temple) or Venore (Shadowthorn).
legend: A bank in Tibia is robbed and can't operate unless the stolen money is returned.

title: Bored Mini World Change
name: Bored Mini World Change
legend: The witch Wyda is bored.

title: Chakoya Iceberg Mini World Change
name: Chakoya Iceberg Mini World Change
legend: Suddenly an iceberg appeared at the north of Tiquanda.

title: Down the Drain Mini World Change
name: Down the Drain Mini World Change

title: Fire from the Earth Mini World Change
name: Fire from the Earth Mini World Change
legend: The Hellgore volcano erupts on Goroma.

title: Grimvale Mini World Change
name: Grimvale Mini World Change
legend: It is full moon on Grimvale, beware!

title: Hive Outpost Mini World Change
name: Hive Outpost Mini World Change
legend: The Hive Born have established an outpost on Vandura.

title: Jungle Camp Mini World Change
name: Jungle Camp Mini World Change
legend: Hunters and Dworcs fight over a camp in the jungle of Tiquanda.

title: Kingsday Mini World Change
name: Kingsday Mini World Change
legend: The capital city of Tibia is completely transformed for the festivities of Kingsday.

title: Lumberjack Mini World Change
name: Lumberjack Mini World Change
legend: Somebody is illegally cutting trees in the forests north of Carlin and Queen Eloise is not amused.

title: Nomads Mini World Change
name: Nomads Mini World Change
legend: Nomads travel through the desert and set up camp in various places.

title: Noodles is Gone Mini World Change
name: Noodles is Gone Mini World Change
legend: The beloved dog of the king is gone, help the king to find him!

title: Oriental Trader Mini World Change
name: Oriental Trader Mini World Change
legend: A trader comes to one of the ports to trade.

title: River Runs Deep Mini World Change
name: River Runs Deep Mini World Change
legend: In the dry zao steppe, suddenly a river is running, containing fish.

title: Spider Nest Mini World Change
name: Spider Nest Mini World Change
location: At the Thaian-Venorean Road, close to Venore.

title: Spirit Grounds Mini World Change
name: Spirit Grounds Mini World Change
location: Spirit Grounds (via Darama, Ghostlands or Vengoth)

title: Stampede Mini World Change
name: Stampede Mini World Change
legend: Something made a group of Elephants, terrified in the jungle.

title: Thawing Mini World Change
name: Thawing Mini World Change
legend: The snow on the glacier north of Svargrond suddenly starts melting.

title: Warpath Mini World Change
name: Warpath Mini World Change
location: Jakundaf Desert, Carlin or Femor Hills
legend: A travelling camp of orcs appears on the mainland of tibia.

title: Tinder Box Quest
name: Tinder Box Quest
legend: Someone died on a remote mountain carrying something extremely valuable for besting the harsh conditions there.

title: Ferumbras' Ascension Quest
name: Ferumbras' Ascension Quest
location: Darashia, the Dungeons of The Ruthless Seven Minions.
legend: Ferumbras is about to gain godlike power and he has to be stopped.

title: Krailos Quest
name: Krailos Quest
legend: The inhabitants of Krailos might need some outside help.

title: Rift Warrior Outfits Quest
name: Rift Warrior Outfits Quest
location: Dungeons of The Ruthless Seven Minions, Adventurer's Guild

title: Small Sapphire Quest
name: Small Sapphire Quest
legend: Plunder a chest containing a pirate captain's savings.

title: Demona Ring Quest
name: Demona Ring Quest
legend: Sorcerers feel like using a ring so now and then.

title: Heart of Destruction Quest
name: Heart of Destruction Quest
location: The Otherworld as reached through the vortices in Zao Steppe, Ankrahmun and Svargrond.
legend: The actions of Ferumbras and the sinister minions of the thing from beyond have shattered the world. These destructive and unnatural forces are trying to devour reality and must be stopped by destroying its heart.

title: Forgotten Knowledge Quest
name: Forgotten Knowledge Quest
location: Halls of Hope and six other areas in Tibia.
legend: Forgotten knowledge from ancient times can be retrieved to enable Imbuing again.

title: The First Dragon Quest
name: The First Dragon Quest
legend: Rumour has it that new clues about the first dragon that had direct contact with humans, Garsharak's son, have come to light. Being the chatterbox he is, Vigintius may know a thing or two about it so make sure to squeeze out any bit of information he has to share.

title: Threatened Dreams Quest
name: Threatened Dreams Quest
location: Fields of Glory, Poacher Caves, Edron, Cormaya, Ulderek's Rock, Venore, Darashia, the Devourer, Feyrist, Candia, and more.
legend: The nightmares that live in Roshamuul are threatening the peaceful existence of the inhabitants of Feyrist.

title: Cults of Tibia Quest
name: Cults of Tibia Quest
location: Outlaw Camp, Ab'Dendriel, Edron Orc Cave, Mintwallin, Carlin Graveyard, Dark Pyramid, Thais and Feyrist.
legend: Secret cults are hiding all over Tibia.

title: Dangerous Depths Quest
name: Dangerous Depths Quest
legend: Gnomes as well as Dwarves have joined forces to analyse and battle an imminent threat, lurking far below the surface.

title: Hidden Threats Quest
name: Hidden Threats Quest
legend: The foreman of the Corym Mines wants you to find out what's behind his decrease in profits, but his workers have other plans...

title: The Secret Library Quest
name: The Secret Library Quest
location: Cormaya, Asura Palace, Ancient Ancestorial Grounds, Falcon Bastion, Deep Desert, The Extension Site and the Secret Library.
legend: Prevent the minions of Variphor from stealing the knowledge about how to use the Godbreaker from the Secret Library of Zathroth.

title: The Fire-Feathered Serpent World Change
name: The Fire-Feathered Serpent World Change
legend: Deep under the Sea, a Fire Feathered Serpent sleeps, but its Guardian needs help protecting their realm.

title: The Dream Courts Quest
name: The Dream Courts Quest
location: Edron, Feyrist, Tyrsung, Tiquanda, Outlaw Camp, Darama, Court of Summer, Court of Winter and the Dream Labyrinth.
legend: The Summer and Winter Courts need help fighting a great threat for the whole world.

title: Winterlight Solstice
name: Winterlight Solstice
legend: The Percht Queen is awakening. Are you brave enough to resist the perishing cold that originates from her chambers and stop it from creating a neverending winter?

title: Tibia Anniversary
name: Tibia Anniversary
legend: Let's celebrate! It's Tibia's birthday! Join us for the party and take part in the festivities! Many exciting activities await you. Try your luck on the piñata dragons. Visit the islands Vigintia and Nostalgia for fun things like can knockdown and a treasure hunt, or take a trip down memory lane.

title: Golden Outfits Quest
name: Golden Outfits Quest
location: King Tibianus (Thais) or Queen Eloise (Carlin) or Emperor Kruzak (Kazordoon).
legend: Shining brightly against the darkness, the legendary golden outfit illuminates the path towards glory and grandeur. Radiating unique magnificence and extravagance, those of royal blood will award it only to the most prestigious and prosperous Tibians in exchange for a generous donation.

title: Grave Danger Quest
name: Grave Danger Quest
location: Thais, Kilmaresh, Cobra Bastion and more.
legend: Sanctify 12 graves of fallen knights to unveil the lich-knights' sinister goals and prevent them from ravaging Tibia and plunging the world into darkness.

title: Kilmaresh Quest
name: Kilmaresh Quest
legend: Explore Kilmaresh and help its citizens.

title: Hand of the Inquisition Outfits Quest
name: Hand of the Inquisition Outfits Quest
location: All the locations of the Grave Danger Quest.
legend: Assist the Inquisition in defeating the lich knights and find rare treasures you can wear to display our success.

title: Orcsoberfest
name: Orcsoberfest
legend: The "games" the brutish Orgers partake in serve as thinly veiled excuses to stuff their maws and fill their bellies, while simultaneously harassing the subservient Orcs.
active_time: From the second Friday until the third Friday of October and March (+following weekend of rewards)

title: Feaster of Souls Quest
name: Feaster of Souls Quest
location: Brain Grounds, Netherworld, Barren Drift and Zarganash
legend: Investigate a series of portals and travel to the Netherworld and Zarganash to uncover the mysteries of the realm between life and death.

title: Poltergeist Outfits Quest
name: Poltergeist Outfits Quest
location: Locations of the Feaster of Souls Quest.
legend: Defeat The Pale Worm to earn the right to be a Poltergeist. Obtain rare ghostly materials to improve your outfit even further.

title: The Order of the Lion Quest
name: The Order of the Lion Quest
legend: Gain the trust of the Order of the Lion and help them fight the usurpers trying to take control of their castle.

title: Soul War Quest
name: Soul War Quest
location: Zarganash, Claustrophobic Inferno, Rotten Wasteland, Ebb and Flow, Furious Crater and Mirrored Nightmare
legend: Assist Goshnar and destroy his personality shards before they grow stronger and escape to the living world.

title: Revenant Outfits Quest
name: Revenant Outfits Quest
location: All the locations of the Soul War Quest.
legend: Help Goshnar defeat the manifestation of his evil traits and earn the right to wear the Revenant Outfits.

title: A Pirate's Tail Quest
name: A Pirate's Tail Quest
legend: Eustacio is looking to ascend in the Venorean society and plans to defeat the Pirats to gain reputation among the merchants.

title: Rascoohan Outfits Quest
name: Rascoohan Outfits Quest
legend: Honour the Rascoohan folk with special gifts and receive their permission to adorn your typical Rascoohan clothes.

title: Adventures of Galthen Quest
name: Adventures of Galthen Quest
location: Bounac, Edron, Port Hope Surroundings, Iksupan
legend: Kesar the Younger's wife, Yselda, has been taken from him. Will you help him investigate the dark forces that took part in this malicious play?

title: Too Hot to Handle Quest
name: Too Hot to Handle Quest
location: Kazordoon, Antrum of the Fallen, Grotto of the Lost, Dwelling of the Forgotten
legend: Strange activities have been reported in a crypt under Kazordoon. Can you handle the heat and help the Gnomes' investigation?

title: Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits Quest
name: Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits Quest
location: Bounac, Bounacean Lion, Forest of Life
legend: Prove your worth to Kesar the Younger to become his Royal Advisor.

title: 25 Years of Tibia Quest
name: 25 Years of Tibia Quest
legend: Explore the history of Tibia's development and fight your way to the past!

title: Formal Dress Outfits Quest
name: Formal Dress Outfits Quest
location: All the locations of the 25 Years of Tibia Quest.

title: Within the Tides Quest
name: Within the Tides Quest
legend: Tarun has noticed the Asuri seem to visit a far away place from time to time. Will you help him investigate it?

title: Primal Ordeal Quest
name: Primal Ordeal Quest
location: Gnomprona, Monster Graveyard, Crystal Enigma and Sparkling Pools.
legend: The Gnomes have discovered a marvelous new place deep under the surface of the world and need help exploring it.

title: The Cradle of Monsters Quest
name: The Cradle of Monsters Quest
legend: A scientist with questionable reputation has been conducting abominable experiments on human beings. Will you stop his madness?

title: Rotten Blood Quest
name: Rotten Blood Quest
location: Blood Vestibule, Jaded Roots, Putrefactory, Gloom Pillars, Darklight Core
legend: Assist the blood god by entering its holy realm of blood and cleansing it from its festering spawn of decay and rot.

title: Decaying Defender Outfits Quest
name: Decaying Defender Outfits Quest
location: All the locations of the Rotten Blood Quest.

title: Nimmersatt's Lair
name: Nimmersatt's Lair
location: Northwest of Carlin, 125.252. The Tibia Observer location is Ice Islands (Carlin).

title: Dragon Slayer Outfits Quest
name: Dragon Slayer Outfits Quest
legend: Legend has it that those who can lay claim to the dragon's breath will one day traverse the land as a revered Dragon Slayer.

title: 20 Years a Cook Quest
name: 20 Years a Cook Quest
location: Venore, Kazordoon, Ghostlands, Edron, Gray Beach, Plains of Havoc, Ankrahmun, Meriana, Muggy Plains
legend: Fleeing the clutches of Nimmersatt, the insatiable dragon, The Draccoon wielded their culinary skills as a disguise. Now liberated, driven by vengeance, they seek allies. Stand with The Draccoon to unveil Nimmersatt's sinister plot and halt his terror from engulfing our realm.

title: Draccoon Herald Outfits Quest
name: Draccoon Herald Outfits Quest
location: All the locations of the 20 Years a Cook Quest.

title: No Rest for the Wicked Quest
name: No Rest for the Wicked Quest
legend: A magical disturbance has appeared at a remote isle, threatening the balance of the world. Investigate the disturbance and fight powerful Inferniarchs to uncover the truth.

title: Fiend Slayer Outfits Quest
name: Fiend Slayer Outfits Quest
legend: A powerful boss named Arbaziloth lurks in the depths of Azzilon, guarding powerful items and unleashing chaos on anyone daring to enter his domain. Only the bravest adventurers will survive the trials of this dangerous quest.

title: Mystery of the Valley Quest
name: Mystery of the Valley Quest
location:
- First piece: Nibelor - Inukaya
- Second piece: Zao - Muggy Plains
- Third piece: Kilmaresh - Kha'zeel

title: The Way of the Monk Quest
name: The Way of the Monk Quest
location: Blue Valley, Targuna, Thais, Tyrsung, Ab'dendriel, Maze of the Lost Souls, Port Hope, Pits of Inferno, Zao, Corruption Hole, Kilmaresh
legend: Follow the path of ancient Merudri to gain wisdom and skills worthy of true monk.

title: Between the Lines Quest
name: Between the Lines Quest
location: Carlin, Edron, Kazordoon (if you're a Sorcerer), Blue Valley (if you are a Monk), and Book World

title: The Order of the Stag Quest
name: The Order of the Stag Quest
legend: Assist Kesar the Younger.

title: The Roost of the Graveborn Quest
name: The Roost of the Graveborn Quest
legend: A mysterious Necromancer emerges and puts Tibia’s Dragons in danger.

title: Targuna Quest
name: Targuna Quest
location: Targuna, Aragonia, Crimson Court, Hidden Lizard Temple
